recentItems.title: Severe thunderstorm damages buildings, closes roads in Toronto area | Hanomansing Tonight
recentItems.description:
An intense weather system brought torrential rain, large hail and the risk of a tornado to parts of southern Ontario on Wednesday. That included the Greater Toronto Area, where a heavy thunderstorm caused widespread power outages and localized flooding and led to the Canadian National Exhibition (CNE) closing early for the evening.

recentItems.title: Why the Nepal flash flood was almost impossible to predict | About That
recentItems.description:
A collapsed glacier in Nepal caused catastrophic flooding that killed more than a thousand people, while thousands more are still missing. Andrew Chang breaks down what accelerated the flood to such a violent degree and how factors like the scale of the Himalayan mountains and the region's climate make prediction and monitoring so challenging.

recentItems.title: Do Americans care about the Canada - U.S. trade war?
recentItems.description:
From boycotting U.S. products, to avoiding travel across the border, to political trash talk – the mood in Canada in relation to the U.S. is definitely "elbows up" these days. But have Americans even noticed they’re in a trade war with Canada? CBC's Washington correspondents Katie Nicholson and Louis Blouin join host Willy Lowry to unpack what they heard in Ohio and Iowa about the escalating tariffs and counter-tariffs, and how Americans feel it could impact their lives and their votes.
